backward_path: A bound charged low-spin object needs its binding carrier to see spin. Make the neutral local bond cell a rotational singlet plus axial triplet, with time-odd axial momentum loaded by the endpoint spin difference. The same interaction lowers occupied adjacent-bond energy and favors antisymmetric spin loading; unlike an imposed Heisenberg coefficient it has dynamical neutral excitation, carrier angular momentum, saturation and matter entanglement.
hilbert_space: Four square-graph sites in a plane. Three separately conserved primitive CAR flavors, one per flavor, at most one total constituent per site. All 2^N primitive spin states, not fixed Sz. Four oriented bond cells, each literal finite |0> plus |x>,|y>,|z> axial vector representation. Position x spin x carrier dimension for N=3 is 24*8*4^4=49152. No harmonic convergence claim.

operators.P_ba: i(|a><0|-|0><a|), axial, parity even, time odd
operators.L_ba: -i epsilon_abc |b><c|, spin-one angular generator; Q and P are vector operators
operators.carrier_H: omega sum_b Pi_triplet(b), neutral dynamics between singlet and triplet induced by loading/hopping
operators.loading: -g sum_b occupied(v_b,w_b) P_b dot (S_at_v-S_at_w). No external J term. Directed cell convention reverses Q_b,P_b signs when the material bond orientation is reversed.
operators.hopping: For a hop v_b -> w_b of flavor i, T_bi=-t I+i lambda Q_b dot S_i; reverse hop Hermitian conjugate. Hard-core occupancy retained. This chosen carrier-assisted spin-orbit interaction is an input, not an emergent Pauli law.
operators.EM: Multiply every full hopping T_bi by exp(i q_i integral_start^end A.dl). J(q)=-dH/dA(-q), contact=d2H/dA(q)dA(-q). No primitive Zeeman term. Magnetic moment=-dH/dB for A=(B/2)(-y,x,0); it is orbital physical charge current, not P re-labelled as magnetization.
operators.generator: J_a=sum_i S_ia+sum_b L_ba. Actual J^2=sum_a J_a^2 measured in full state; carrier contributions and spin/carrier sharing retained. SU(2) rotates internal axial cells and spins; square embedding has only discrete orbital symmetry, not a continuous orbital rotation generator. Full continuum total spatial angular momentum is NOT established.
operators.integrated_out_prediction: At weak g/omega, -g^2/omega (S_i-S_j)^2=-3g^2/(2omega)+2g^2/omega S_i.S_j on occupied bonds; attraction and AF arise from same dynamical loading. This is a diagnostic perturbative prediction, not substituted for full finite carrier consumer. Sum-loading competitor has the opposite exchange sign.

controls: Execute sum loading first, then difference loading; compute full dressed pair+single and three-single breakup in separate same-size graph boxes under same parameters. No-spin-loading control g=0 retains spin-orbit and carrier dynamics; no-carrier control sets g=lambda=0 and removes neutral Hilbert factor. lambda=0 retains binding/spin selection. The isotropic physical current commutes with internal J, so scalar orbital chirality must not be falsely credited as spin magnetism.
response_scope: Entire Peierls physical current and contact including spin-orbit, finite-q 3 Cartesian components (out-of-plane zero on planar graph), diagonal frequency spectral measures by full-state Krylov and complex equal-time cross-component Gram. Full frequency off-diagonal tensor is not supplied. Local directed charge currents and opposite-polarization orbital magnetic response are measured. No dynamical EM photon is present.
material_alternative: NEW executed occupied-bond axial pre-twist -u n_v n_w Q_bz, u=.35 along the explicit axial normal of the planar material. Time even and parity even; not a Zeeman source. The same local cells then load both density and spin, and their explicit spin-orbit hopping may lock physical orbital current to polarization. This normal/pre-twist is a new primitive material input, not a dynamically derived free-space orientation. Jz conserved, but J2 is measured rather than assumed and generally not conserved. Finite useful spin-current response does NOT establish a true spin-half particle for this anisotropic alternative.
loading_only_magnetic_fork: actual3 polarization traces found a larger real spin-dependent orbital moment with explicit spin-orbit lambda=0 than with lambda=.22. magnetic1 therefore executes the physically superior fork lambda=0, u=.35: bare hopping is spin blind, but moving spin-difference rotational loading and axial pre-twist produce position-dependent spin/neutral entanglement and a physical charge loop current. It recomputes dressed breakup, full current/contact, no-spin-loading g=0, reversed pre-twist, zero pre-twist, moment spectra and polarization traces. g P.(S_v-S_w) is still an explicit primitive spin-carrier interaction; no primitive spin or axial material orientation is derived.
source_correction: actual1 preserved in capsule: single-vector eigsh omitted exact degenerate partners, so first polarized means were not valid spin comparisons; first continuity sign was wrong. Successor restores time reversal and angular-generator symmetry orbits, uses [H,rho(q)]=q.J(q), and measures lowest Jz=3/2 comparison without restricting the ground search. actual2 exposed opposite time-reversed orbital currents even without spin-orbit. actual3 therefore measures moment spectra and polarization traces over the restored symmetry-generated ground blocks, separating arbitrary pure-state orbital preparation from spin response; the restored block is not an independent proof of complete ground degeneracy. Explicit full neutral/no-spin-dependent g=lambda=0 control is also executed.
threshold_scope: Dressed disconnected finite graph fragments, not infinite-volume scattering/continuum thresholds. Each fragment has its own neutral cells and field vacuum baseline zero.
